p: on wind: That is, flatters himself with vain confidence.
oil is carried into Egypt: Meaning presents to get friendship.
Judah: Which in those points was similar to Ephraim, but not in idolatry.
power with God: Seeing that God in this way preferred Jacob their father, Judah's ingratitude was the more to be abhorred.
power over the angel: Read Ge 32:24-32.

he found him in Bethel: God found Jacob as he lay sleeping in Bethel Ge 28:12, and spoke with him there in such a way that the fruit of that speech appertained to the whole body of the people, of which we are.
a merchant: As for Ephraim, he is more like the wicked Canaanites than godly Abraham or Jacob.
that were sin: Thus way the wicked measure God's favour by outward prosperity, and like hypocrites cannot endure that any should reprove their doings.
the days of the solemn feast: Seeing you will not acknowledge my benefits, I will bring you again to dwell in tents, as in the feast of the Tabernacles, which you now condemn.
iniquity in Gilead: The people thought that no man dare have spoken against Gilead, that holy place, and yet the Prophet says that all their religion was but vanity.
And Jacob fled into the country: If you boast of your riches and nobility, you seem to reproach your father, who was a poor fugitive and servant.
prophet the LORD brought Israel out: Meaning Moses, by which appears that whatever they have, it comes from God's free goodness.
